grammar_card.title: a / an / some / the 怎么用(冠词)
grammar_card.intro: 本课讲名词前面的小词——冠词。全用本课句子举例。

rows: a + 读音辅音开头的可数单数;an + 读音元音开头(看发音,不看字母:a university / an hour)
a beggar / an apartment / an hour
some + 可数名词复数 或 不可数名词(表'一些 / 不确定数量')
第一次提到某物用 a/an;再次提到同一个、或特指时用 the
泛指一类事物时,复数名词/不可数名词前不加 the(也不加 a)
Everybody knows him. / Milk is good.(泛指)
人名、街名等专有名词前不用 a 或 the

specialRules.rule: 单数可数名词不能光秃秃单独用,前面必须有 a/an/the/my… 之类
不可数名词靠量词计数:a cup of coffee / a piece of cake / a glass of water

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What did the beggar do in return for the food?
options: He stood on his head and sang

passage: I have just moved into an apartment on Oak Street. Yesterday a beggar knocked on my door. He asked me for a sandwich and a cup of coffee. In return, the beggar stood on his head and sang a funny song. I gave him some food. He ate the sandwich and drank the coffee. Then he put a cookie in his pocket and walked away. Later, a neighbor told me about him. Everybody on the street knows him — his name is Percy Buttons. He calls at every house once a month. He always asks for a meal and never takes money.
